title: Study and skills seminar
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by technology/study-club seminar themes in the user's materials; no recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a study and skills club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
questions: Which skill would you like to improve?
Do you prefer group or individual study?
What digital tool do you use most?

tasks.prompt: The club is planning a short seminar for new members. Write a short message describing one topic that would be useful.
Members are discussing how the seminar should be organised.
questions: Which practical skill should be taught first?
Would an online, face-to-face or hybrid seminar work best?
How could the club support members with different levels of experience?

tasks.prompt: The club announces that the seminar will now take place only online and members must pay a small registration fee. Write to a friend about your reaction and suggestion.
Write a formal email to the club secretary about the online-only seminar and registration fee. Explain possible disadvantages and propose a more flexible arrangement for members.
